descriptions.text: Warning: This item can only be used by a female. Or a male, if you're a seahorse. It's a flower. You're supposed to eat it, though it might be a good decoration instead. […] Anyway, if you eat this flower, it renders you unconscious for one hour with your health at 1% of your max. You cannot heal during this time. If you survive this ordeal, you will be given one of three permanent boons from the goddess Eileithyia. The given boon is at the discretion of the goddess, and it cannot be predicted. If you choose to worship Eileithyia before you consume this flower, the descriptions of the boons will be expanded. She will also ask you which of the three you'd prefer. Her cooperation is not guaranteed, especially if she doesn't like you. But Eileithyia is known to be a generous goddess.

beats.headline: Inside the Engaged Lock Box of the Night Wyrm
beats.text: The system is characteristically unhelpful: "It's a flower. You're supposed to eat it, though it might be a good decoration instead. It probably tastes like a bullshit salad at some hippie vegan restaurant with a month-long waiting list." Eating it means an hour unconscious at 1% health with healing blocked. Survive and Eileithyia grants one of three permanent boons, her choice — unless you worship her first, in which case she expands the descriptions and asks your preference. Her cooperation is not guaranteed.

beats.headline: Katia's way out
beats.text: She takes it and leaves the crawl, human again and missing pieces of herself.
